$extensions.aesthetic: content-first canvas — warm-neutral minimalism built on block-based layout rhythm

surface.$description: White canvas — clean content-first page background

surface-subtle.$description: Warm off-white — sidebar, secondary surfaces, hover backgrounds

surface-hover.$description: Block hover state — light warm gray

accent.$description: Notion Blue — links, selected states, interactive highlights

accent-hover.$description: Darker Notion Blue — hover state for accent elements

text-primary.$description: Warm charcoal — primary content text, Notion's signature text tone

text-secondary.$description: Medium warm gray — secondary text, descriptions, metadata

text-tertiary.$description: Light warm gray — placeholders, empty-state text, timestamps

text-on-accent.$description: White text on Notion Blue backgrounds

icon-default.$description: Default icon color — slightly lighter than text-primary

notion-brown.$description: Notion Brown — icon and text accent

notion-orange.$description: Notion Orange — icon accent, text highlight

notion-red.$description: Notion Red — destructive actions, error states

notion-blue-icon.$description: Notion Blue icon variant — softer than accent blue

notion-purple.$description: Notion Purple — tag and text accent

notion-pink.$description: Notion Pink — icon and text accent

bg-gray.$description: Gray background tint — callout, inline code, tag background

border.$description: Standard warm border — dividers, card edges, table lines

border-dark.$description: Heavier border — active states, emphasized separation

cta-black.$description: Black CTA button — Notion marketing pages use solid black buttons

cta-black-hover.$description: Black CTA hover — softens to warm charcoal

font-display.$value: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, 'Apple Color Emoji', Arial, sans-serif, 'Segoe UI Emoji', 'Segoe UI Symbol'
font-display.$description: System font stack — same for headings and body (Notion uses no custom display font)

font-body.$value: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, 'Apple Color Emoji', Arial, sans-serif, 'Segoe UI Emoji', 'Segoe UI Symbol'
font-body.$description: System font stack — identical to display (unified typeface system)

font-serif.$description: Serif option — user-selectable page font in Notion

scale-hero.$description: Hero headline — marketing pages, landing sections

scale-h1.$description: Heading 1 — page title and H1 blocks

scale-ui.$description: UI text — buttons, menus, sidebar items, captions

weight-medium.$description: Medium — buttons, nav items, UI labels

weight-bold.$description: Bold — H1, hero headlines, page titles

unit.$description: Base unit — Notion uses a 4px micro-grid within blocks

2xs.$description: Hairline — inline element gaps, icon-to-text micro-gap

xs.$description: Tight — padding within inline tags, list bullet offset

sm.$description: Small — inner block padding, menu item gaps

md.$description: Medium — card padding, sidebar item spacing

lg.$description: Large — gap between content blocks, section sub-spacing

xl.$description: Extra large — heading-to-body gap, card grid gaps

2xl.$description: Double extra large — section divider spacing

3xl.$description: Triple extra large — major section breaks

container-content.$description: Content column max-width — Notion page body

container-wide.$description: Wide layout — marketing pages, full-width databases

radius-tight.$description: Tight radius — inline tags, small badges, buttons

radius-standard.$description: Standard radius — input fields, dropdown menus

radius-comfortable.$description: Comfortable radius — cards, modal corners, callout blocks

radius-pill.$description: Pill shape — filter chips, status badges

level-0.$description: Border shadow — 1px bottom line simulating a border, Notion's default card separator

level-1.$description: Light elevation — dropdown menus, tooltips, popover panels

level-2.$description: Heavy elevation — modals, command palette, overlay dialogs

duration-instant.$description: Instant — hover state changes, toggle switches, checkbox ticks

duration-fast.$description: Fast — dropdown open, menu slide, tooltip appearance

duration-normal.$description: Normal — page transitions, panel slide, sidebar toggle

easing-default.$description: Standard ease — smooth deceleration, used for most transitions

easing-snappy.$description: Snappy ease-out — menu appearances, quick interactions
